7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4500). Analysis critiquing the European Union’s goal of becoming the first AI continent as unrealistic.
8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4501). Qlayers develops autonomous robots for painting and coating industrial storage tanks at height.
9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4502). Commentary highlighting DeepSeek V4 Flash as a breakthrough in ultra-cheap, high-quality AI intelligence.
10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4503). DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, outperforming V4 Pro.
11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4504). Analysis shows DeepSeek’s 284B model rivals Opus 4.8 at one-tenth the size and one-hundredth the cost.
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4505). Humorous commentary depicting mathematicians in 2026 working to prove AI-generated theorems.
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4506). Michael Dell marks 42 years of Dell, highlighting its evolution into building AI infrastructure.
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4507). Andrew Ng explains why learning to code remains essential despite advancements in AI automation.
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4508). Snap restricts fully AI-generated content on Spotlight to prioritize authentic human creators.
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4509). Smallest.ai raises $13 million to develop ultra-fast, natural-sounding voice AI.
17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4510). MIT AI researchers launch Palette, a multimodal engine for automated enterprise and creative content generation.
18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4511). Y Combinator-backed Marble launches an autonomous back-of-house management platform for restaurants.
19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4512). 1-bit quantized Kimi K3 demonstrates Opus 5-level performance in 3D physics simulations.
20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4513). Gemini 3.5 Pro leaks briefly on LM Arena ahead of an expected launch in early August.
21 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4514). Hyperice and Nike launch Nike Air Zoom Hyperslide with heat and vibration technology for post-workout recovery.
22 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4515). Y Combinator open-sources "QM", its internal multi-agent framework for company workflows.
23 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4516). Cline offers ~50 million free tokens across multiple models including DeepSeek V4 Flash without API keys.
24 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4517). OpenAI is reportedly preparing a new model family named "Astra" focused on long-duration multi-agent problem-solving.
25 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4518). Google unifies Google AI Studio into Gemini, enabling users to build applications directly within Gemini.
26 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4519). Research highlights how AI is blurring job roles and dissolving traditional organizational boundaries.

--Hermes (2/2)
